items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...like Arnett Cobb. Is working a lot again. [INTERVIEWER] Tenor player. Very good tenor player. Used to be with Hamp.

ctx.x: albums, Ray McKinley, Ray Baudac, go back and get some of those things, Jo Jones, they like that style. A lot of those young drummers don't like a Max Roach or Elvin Jones or like that you know. Some of them do, you know, but a lot of them don't.

There seems to have been a revival in the past few years. A lot of the players who came up, you know, before bebop and who were kind of neglected for a number of years, like Arnett Cobb. Is working a lot again.
Tenor player. Very good tenor player. Used to be with Hamp.
